name: net_lod_arrival_party_probe
description: VUH-2342 diagnosis (not a regression): the host warps into LoD's first-visit arrival 08/00 door 50 evt 19, skips the event and accepts Ping's forced party change while the friend is held. Records both games' LoD party row (SAVE+0x3534+4*8), resolved party members and party actors before and after.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))

steps.name: 1 The host enters LoD 08/00 door 50 evt 19 (the first-visit arrival event)

steps.expr: [location(0), location(1), [peek(0x9ACE04,'u32',i) for i in range(2)], peek('0xB65210','i32',0)]
[location(0), location(1), [peek(0x9ACE04,'u32',i) for i in range(2)], peek('0x7435D0','u8',0)]

steps.name: 2 The host accepts Ping's forced party change

steps.expr: [location(0), location(1), [peek(0x9ACE04,'u32',i) for i in range(2)], [[peek(0x2A25300+2*k,'u16',i) for k in range(4)] for i in range(2)], [sorted(a['name'] for a in actors(i) if a['name'][:2] in ('P_','N_') or a['name'].startswith('F_MU1')) for i in range(2)], peek('0x7435D0','u8',0), peek('0x7435D0','u8',1)]

[location(0), location(1), [peek(0x9ACE04,'u32',i) for i in range(2)], [[peek(0x2A25300+2*k,'u16',i) for k in range(4)] for i in range(2)], [sorted(a['name'] for a in actors(i) if a['name'][:2] in ('P_','N_') or a['name'].startswith('F_MU1')) for i in range(2)]]
